systems.system: CNEDOGE documentation mission to Annobón (identity documents and passports)
systems.owner: Centro Nacional de Emisión de Documentos de Guinea Ecuatorial (CNEDOGE)
systems.tiers: a seven-day visiting commission to San Antonio de Palé, Annobón, from mid-July 2026, the third such visit; no permanent CNEDOGE office in the province

note: An identity-document and passport issuance mission by CNEDOGE; the Registro Civil is named only in the Annobón notary's appeal to parents to register births, with nothing on how the record is made.
